questions.question: What are the standard working hours?
questions.ground_truth: 9 AM to 6 PM, Monday through Friday, with a one-hour lunch break.

questions.question: How many annual leave days do employees get?
questions.ground_truth: 20 paid days per calendar year, after completing probation.

questions.question: How many sick leave days are available?
questions.ground_truth: Up to 10 paid days per year.

questions.question: Can employees work remotely?
questions.ground_truth: The handbook covers remote work arrangements; details are in the policy.

questions.question: How do I contact the IT Help Desk?
questions.ground_truth: Provide your name, device, a short description of the problem, any error messages, what you were doing when it happened, and steps you already tried. Attach a screenshot if helpful, after removing confidential data.

questions.question: What should I do if I suspect a security issue?
questions.ground_truth: Report possible account compromise immediately, change passwords, and let IT handle investigations.

questions.question: How do I troubleshoot Wi-Fi problems?
questions.ground_truth: Ensure you're connected to the NexaTech-Employees network, toggle Wi-Fi, restart the device, and contact IT if it still fails.

questions.question: Can I install any software on my work device?
questions.ground_truth: Only approved software should be installed. Request needed applications through the IT Help Desk.

questions.question: How do I set up email on my device?
questions.ground_truth: Use the approved email app, check the internet connection, restart the app, and report issues with device details.

questions.question: What is the resignation process?
questions.ground_truth: Submit a resignation, serve the required notice period, and follow up with your manager and HR.
